next.reason: 1985: in START 'Data-name-1 may be qualified.' 2023's START clause (14.9.41) has no such sentence, but the general qualification rules apply to every reference: §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 'uniqueness shall be established through a sequence of qualifiers' and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 'A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification'. Nothing in 14.9.41.3 forbids qualifying data-name-1, so a qualified data-name-1 is accepted with the same meaning.
